verdict.rationale: Apple's docs explicitly describe iPhone Mirroring, which lets you "see and use your iPhone right from your Mac" and "view and control your iPhone right from your Mac desktop". This directly matches the story. Related Continuity features add phone control from the Mac: making and taking calls, and remotely activating the iPhone's Personal Hotspot. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of iPhone Mirroring's scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration that it works well in daily use, and support beyond iPhone (only iPhone is evidenced).
